title: Invertible Transport Between Sample-Only Distributions via Projected Characteristic Functions
abstract: arXiv:2611.26187v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many useful latent distributions can be sampled but do not have a tractable density. Such distributions may be represented by empirical collections of real-world observations or generated by scientific simulators and black-box generative models. These sample-only priors cannot be used directly in likelihood-based normalizing flows, which require evaluating the prior density. We propose Projected Characteristic-Function matching (PCF), a density-free framework for learning an invertible map between a data distribution and a prior specified only through samples.   Our method aligns distributions using projected empirical characteristic functions, eliminating the need for density estimation, adversarial training, or paired observations. To address the non-uniqueness of the transport map, we introduce an optional transport regularizer that selects lower-displacement transformations while preserving endpoint alignment.   We benchmark PCF on c

tldr: 该论文提出了一种免密度框架PCF（投影特征函数匹配），通过投影经验特征函数学习仅样本分布之间的可逆传输映射，无需密度估计、对抗训练或配对观测，并通过可选的传输正则化器选择低位移变换。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Projected Characteristic-Function matching (PCF), a density-free framework for learning invertible transport maps between sample-only distributions using projected empirical characteristic functions, eliminating the need for density estimation, adversarial training, or paired observations, with an optional transport regularizer that selects lower-displacement transformations.
